2607.19253.title: Sequential Learner Modeling Using Multi-Relational Graph Convolutional Networks
2607.19253.paper_summary: User modeling is a critical task in a variety of personalized systems. Recognizing their effectiveness in learning from graph-structured data, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), particularly Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs), are increasingly employed for user modeling. However, existing approaches typically treat different relation types in a graph as homogeneous, limiting their ability to capture richer semantics and construct more informative user models. While multi-relational GNNs (MR-GNNs) have been adopted for representation learning and recommendation, their application for user modeling remains unexplored. Moreover, existing GNN-based user modeling approaches ignore the user interaction sequence. To address these research gaps, in this work we propose MR-ConceptGCN, a novel fully unsupervised approach focused on concept-based sequential learner modeling using multi-relational GCNs (MR-GCNs). MR-ConceptGCN effecively combines Personal Knowledge Graphs (PKGs), MR-GCNs, and the pre-trained language model SBERT to obtain enhanced relation- and semantic-aware representations of the PKG items. The enriched embeddings of the knowledge concepts that a learner did not understand when interacting with learning materials in CourseMapper are then used to construct a sequential learner model that combines long-term and short-term learner interactions. We report the results of an online user study (n = 31), demonstrating the benefits of MR-ConceptGCN in terms of several important user-centric aspects including accuracy, usefulness, diversity, and satisfaction with an educational recommender system.
2607.19253.paper_summary_zh: 使用者建模是在各種個性化系統中一項關鍵任務。<lb/>由於其在從圖結構數據中學習的有效性，圖神經網絡（GNNs），特別是圖卷積網絡（GCNs），越來越多地被用於使用者建模。<lb/>然而，現有的方法通常將圖中的不同關係類型視為同質，限制了它們捕捉更豐富語義和構建更具信息性的使用者模型的能力。<lb/>儘管多關係GNN（MR-GNNs）已被採用於表示學習和推薦，但其在使用者建模中的應用仍然未被探索。<lb/>此外，現有的基於GNN的使用者建模方法忽略了使用者互動序列。<lb/>為了解決這些研究空白，在本研究中，我們提出了MR-ConceptGCN，一種新穎的完全無監督方法，專注於使用多關係GCN（MR-GCNs）進行基於概念的序列學習者建模。<lb/>MR-ConceptGCN有效地結合了個人知識圖（PKGs）、MR-GCNs和預訓練語言模型SBERT，以獲得增強的關係和語義感知的PKG項目表示。<lb/>在CourseMapper中，學習者在與學習材料互動時未理解的知識概念的豐富嵌入被用來構建一個結合長期和短期學習者互動的序列學習者模型。<lb/>我們報告了一項在線使用者研究的結果（n = 31），展示了MR-ConceptGCN在準確性、有用性、多樣性和對教育推薦系統的滿意度等幾個重要以使用者為中心的方面的好處。
